note: This receipt adds Memory64 boundary tests and documentation. The Minidump parser is unchanged.
covered: each Memory64 descriptor's 64-bit file offset is validated against the dump length before slicing
the descriptor size is compared with the remaining file bytes
offset addition cannot overflow into an in-file range
the list-wide base RVA advances by each descriptor's size: two ranges read AAAABBBB at the correct distinct offsets
a truncated descriptor list returns a parse error without panic
out-of-file descriptors return a parse error without panic or partial memory ranges on success
